children: Singapore's economy grew by 5.4% ‌in the third quarter from ​a year ​earlier, preliminary government data ⁠showed on ​Wednesday.
Economists polled ​by Reuters had expected annual growth ​of 5.0% ​in the July-September period.
On ‌a ⁠quarter-on-quarter, seasonally adjusted basis, gross domestic product grew 1.1% ​from ​the ⁠second quarter of 2026, ​according ​to ⁠advance estimates from the trade ⁠ministry.
